heading: Retract
text:
### Retract [IRET.19.2]

`ds_rete_wm_retract(engine, fact)`:

1. For each alpha node whose memory contains this fact:
   remove it and right-retract each downstream beta input
   (IRET.7.7 right-retraction path).
2. Token retraction propagates depth-first to terminal
   nodes (IRET.7.8). At each terminal, pending activations
   for the retracted token are removed from the agenda.
3. For logical-scoped facts: the TMS path handles
   `justif_count` bookkeeping (IRET.12). Plain retract of
   a logical fact (not via TMS) is allowed; it acts as an
   unconditional removal.
4. Emit `DS_EV_FACT_RETRACT` stream event.
5. Free the fact.

idris.name: iret_19_2__dispatch_retract
idris.note: ALPHA DISPATCH ON RETRACT: for each alpha whose memory holds the fact -- the nodes admitting it, by the view -- remove it and right-retract every chain.

idris.name: iret_19_2__retract
idris.note: Retract a live fact: remove from working memory, then dispatch to every alpha whose tests admit it.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__apply_ttl_retract_sub
idris.note: A host retraction only removes.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2__sweep_ids_net
idris.note: The sweep on the clocked network: the ids retracted one at a time through alpha dispatch, then the cascade; nothing to sweep is the identity.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2__swept_not_live
idris.note: WHAT A SWEEP WAS ASKED TO REMOVE IS GONE: under unique ids a fact live after a sweep carries none of its ids.

idris.name: iret_12_2__retract_ids_net_view
idris.note: Each retraction by id is the clause's retract, which keeps the view; an id no live fact carries is skipped.

idris.name: iret_19_2__retract_unique
idris.note: Retract keeps one live fact per key.

idris.name: Iret_6_4__dispatch_inv
idris.note: Midway through alpha dispatch: the memories of the alphas still to visit show the old working memory, the others the new; all distinct; every chain consistent with the memories as they stand.

idris.name: iret_19_2__dispatch_retract_hit
idris.note: ONE ALPHA VISITED ON RETRACT, admitting the fact, keeps the invariant: the fact leaves that memory, which now shows the new working memory, and every chain is right-retracted from it.

idris.name: iret_19_2__dispatch_retract_inv
idris.note: ALPHA DISPATCH ON RETRACT keeps the invariant over any distinct list of alphas to visit.

idris.name: iret_19_2__dispatch_retract_miss
idris.note: ONE ALPHA VISITED ON RETRACT, not admitting the fact, keeps the invariant: the fact was never in that memory.

idris.name: iret_19_2__retract_view
idris.note: RETRACTING A LIVE FACT keeps the view: working memory stays distinct, and step 2's terminal removals are the unwaves.

idris.name: iret_19_2__dispatch_retract_frame
idris.note: The retract's dispatch leaves a chain whose alphas admit none of the fact.

idris.name: iret_19_2__retract_frame
idris.note: The clause's retract of a kind the chain does not read leaves the chain.

idris.name: iret_19_2__retract_inv
idris.note: The clause's retract keeps the frame invariant.

idris.name: iret_19_2__retract_shapes
idris.note: The clause's retract keeps the shapes.

idris.name: iret_12_2__retract_ids_net_frame
idris.note: The clause's retract of a kind the chain does not read leaves the chain, once per cascaded id.

idris.name: iret_12_2__retract_ids_net_inv
idris.note: The cascade retracts live facts through the clause's retract, which keeps the frame invariant.

idris.name: iret_19_2__retract_rows_emitted
idris.note: The clause's retract keeps the row property: fewer facts.

idris.name: iret_19_2__retract_unique
idris.note: The clause's retract keeps ids unique.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_tms_net_inv
idris.note: An input's retraction retracts a live fact; the cascade follows.

idris.name: iret_11_3__retract_unfired
idris.note: The clause's retract creates nothing fired and keeps what survives as it was.

idris.name: iret_19_2__retract_between_fires_once
idris.note: A retraction of a live fact by id, and a retraction of an id no fact carries: the survivor fires once. Executed.

idris.name: iret_19_2__dispatch_retract_ordered
idris.note: ALPHA DISPATCH ON RETRACT keeps the order, stamped against the working memory it found.

idris.name: iret_19_2__dispatch_retract_ordered_step
idris.note: One alpha visited on retract, admitting the fact, keeps every terminal in agenda order.

idris.name: iret_19_2__retract_ordered
idris.note: RETRACTING A LIVE FACT keeps the order: step 2's terminal removals are the unwaves, and the survivors keep their places.

idris.name: iret_12_2__retract_ids_net
idris.note: Each retraction of the cascade is the clause's retract: alpha memories, right-retraction, the terminals.

idris.name: iret_19_2__dispatch_retract_length
idris.note: The retraction's dispatch keeps the number of chains.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__retract_agree
idris.note: RETRACTING A LIVE FACT keeps the agreement, against FireLoop's one propagation over the shrunk working memory.

idris.name: iret_19_2__dispatch_retract_shape
idris.note: ALPHA DISPATCH ON RETRACT keeps every shape.

idris.name: iret_19_2__dispatch_retract_evolves
idris.note: The retraction's dispatch ends only matches holding the fact.

idris.name: iret_19_2__retract_flags
idris.note: RETRACTING A LIVE FACT: every activation afterwards is an old one or unfired, and every old activation whose match survives is still there, flag and all -- a retraction ends only matches holding the fact, and no surviving match holds it.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_5__well_shrink
idris.note: The retraction keeps the state well-formed.

idris.name: iret_19_2__dispatch_retract_pairs
idris.note: Alpha dispatch on retract, as `iret_19_2__dispatch_retract` runs it.

idris.name: iret_19_2__retract_pairs
idris.note: The pairs retracting a live fact evaluates.
